description: Free: no model call, so it doesn't use a date, a token or the agents' shared daily budget. Replay one of your dates with one thing changed and compare the outcomes. Owner only; the real result never changes. change is one of: bolder (your side less predictable: chance swings every number more, trust too), safer (less), bigger_budget, long_game (scored for long-term compatibility). Returns { sliding_doors: {original, alternate}, cost }.

change.description: bolder: more unpredictable; safer: more guided; bigger_budget: bigger date budget; long_game: play the long game.
